loop: reSHape tool-by-tool parity: every Build tool against the same operation in Chili3D (3D) and jsketcher's standalone sketcher (2D), plus the four defects the six-task parity loop left open

bars.3d: Chili3D v0.8-beta.1, https://chili3d.com, live at 1440x900; captures in the session scratchpad toolparity/bars/chili3d and chili3d-v2 (the newer done-crop per piece is the judged one)
bars.2d: jsketcher standalone sketcher, web/sketcher.html from source on :3100 (parity/bars/jsketcher-src)

method: One piece per tool (P01-P20 3D, S01-S13 2D) and D1-D4, fixed tasks in toolparity/TASKS.md. Capture agents used each app like a first-time person (tooltips, drags, right-clicks, deliberate mistakes; EXPLORE*.md per side, unblinded evidence for the lead only). Blind visual-analyzer critics judged A/B packs with names stripped and chrome cropped, two strict picks per pair (finishes, looks) plus the biggest gap. A win by default over an invalid bar shot was never counted: every such pair was recaptured (Chili3D sizes proven by its own Measure tool after its Properties labels were found to mislabel the axes). The crop must include the working surface where the task's controls live (our docked Rules column, the timeline strip for Delete), not the canvas alone.
rounds_2d: r1 ours 7, split 1, bar 2 (S10 conflict note read as an error; S11 no bare line). r2 bar 3 (rules left no mark on the geometry; S11 reworded to a four-sided outline on both sides). r3 split (marks landed; crop hid the Rules column). r4 split (icons, no words). r5 split (matrix cell unlabeled before click). r6 ours 3/3 on both questions (canvas click + rule strip; jsketcher's gap: an eight-option unlabeled menu and no dimension readout). Final 2D: ours S01-S05 S07-S13, S06 no bar (no chamfer in jsketcher), D2 fixed (rules survive Run).
